topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I found a package on my doorstep, addressed to someone I've never met. The name concatenated in my mind with the previous tenant's, a realization that brought a heavy weight to my chest. Opening it seemed intrusive; leaving it untouched felt like a small betrayal of the person who was rightfully expecting it. I should call the sender or the postal service, but the thought of admitting my mistake made me hesitate. The package sat there, a silent reproach. I need to find the right thing to do, to make sure it reaches the hands it was meant for.
